name: @auto-pigeon/incident-contract
description: The cross-stack incident contract: a versioned, bounded incident envelope, the canonical incident-code taxonomy, the correlation-id convention every Auto-Pigeon component propagates, the central redaction rules, and the versioned user bug-report document (auto-pigeon-bug-report/1.1, with its three mandatory GitHub labels). Contract data plus a dependency-free reference implementation — no transport, no SDK, no running service.
